name: claude-jev
description: Hands the small judgments in a session to TypeSafe's Jev, a System One model that returns typed answers instead of generating text: what kind of request each prompt is, which model tier a subagent needs, whether an edit breaks a rule already written in your CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, and which transcript blocks survive compaction. Kept blocks carry over verbatim — no LLM writes a summary.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe or OpenRouter API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Saved from /claude-jev and hidden in /config so the value is never shown. A non-empty TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the launch environment wins. An sk-or- key calls OpenRouter.

promptRouter.title: Prompt routing hints
promptRouter.description: Classify each prompt and add a routing hint.

subagentRouter.title: Subagent model routing
subagentRouter.description: Pick a subagent's model and check its brief before the spawn.

rules.title: Rule checks
rules.description: Check edits and turn ends against the rules in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Replace the compaction summary with the transcript blocks Jev keeps. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
